COMPRESSED_BACKEND_ARCHITECTURE.pair_model: two disjoint namespaces A and B over the same sealed certificate
COMPRESSED_BACKEND_ARCHITECTURE.arithmetic_layer: word-level exact MacroIR constraints; no eager scalar-bit expansion

PROOF_CARRYING_DECISION_DAG.learned_conflict_authority: ZERO unless accompanied by an independently checkable derivation
PROOF_CARRYING_DECISION_DAG.memoization_rule: subproblem reuse requires byte-identical canonical residual state or a separately certified exact equivalence proof; hash equality alone is insufficient
PROOF_CARRYING_DECISION_DAG.complete_UNSAT_authority: root node must be independently checkable as an exhaustive proof DAG whose every leaf is a valid UNSAT leaf
